violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized during inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Chicken, beans, and steak were observed cooling on racks in the kitchen area. PIC placed in walk-in cooler for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026
Several refrigerator/freezer door gaskets were observed in poor repair. PIC has invoice of purchase of new gaskets. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026
The hand-washing sinks in the dishwashing area and women's restroom were lacking handwashing signage. PIC put up signs during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
Inspector observed an open bag of cheese with a dead fly stored in the 2 door cooler. PIC discarded cheese. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (mandoline slicer and food chopper) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
Employees' medicines were not stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, or utensils. PIC relocated medication. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Various meat items were observed cooling on a speed rack in the back kitchen area. PIC placed items in walk-in cooler for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by nesting material (cabinet under soda machine) and droppings (cabinet under soda machine and office). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
Several refrigerator/freezer door gaskets were observed in poor repair. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - all cooler units including doors, door gaskets, and racks - knife rack - shelves under prep units New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026

The floors in the office and under soda machine area has an accumulation of droppings/nesting material. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/08/2026
Inspector observed a leak below both hand sinks. PIC informed and called plumber. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024
Inspector observed refuse area with unnecessary equipment near dumpsters. Area needs to be properly cleaned and maintained. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024

The Person in charge was not knowledgeable of cold holding, proper cooling, and its methods, etc. The person in charge must demonstrate to the health department knowledge of foodborne disease prevention, application of HACCP principles, and the requirements of this Code. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
The hand-washing sink in the service area was blocked by equipment. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. New Violation. Correct By: 12/04/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice maker) were observed with an accumulation of brown residue and other debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
Establishment is using non-continous cooking of raw animal foods and is lacking witten procedures. PIC informed to submit written procedures. New Violation. Correct By: 12/06/2024

Birria soup, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024

Shrimp and refried beans were observed held between 109-120 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Items reheated during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC corrected by labeling the bottle on site. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, soup was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep the night before. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
Containers of fry oil were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
Freezer door gaskets were observed in poor repair. Heavey accumilation of ice and frost buildup within unit. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the refridgerator units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
The hand sinks are lacking hot water. PIC contacted service during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024

Inspector observed refuse area with unnecessary equipment near dumpsters and grease build up on and around grease bins. Area needs to be properly cleaned and maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 12/17/2024
Mops must be allowed to air dry after use. New Violation. Correct By: 12/03/2024
